_help: Copy this file to config.json (or just run pipeline.py once - it does the copy for you), then edit the values below.

courses: one entry per class you want grabbed (the two here are examples - replace them with yours). Any fragment of the course's name or code works; it is matched against your live D2L enrollments, so a new semester just means replacing this list.
output_dir: the master archive, kept in this folder next to the scripts. Every run updates it in place, only fetching what is new or changed.

publish_dir: a second, browse-friendly mirror of the archive (e.g. an Obsidian vault). Leave it "" to mirror into Documents/dataGrubber in your home folder; set a full path to choose your own destination.
request_delay_seconds: politeness delay between API calls.

course_total_points: what a course's grades add up to. UMGC's standard is 1000, but an instructor can deviate; use a number for all courses or a map like {"ARIN 440": 100} for exceptions (unlisted courses stay 1000).
ai_scrape: when true, external links (articles, videos) found in the archive become AI-digested study copies saved next to the file that linked them. Only new links are processed each run.

ai_scrape_provider: which AI does the digesting. "claude" (default, the optimized case): a headless Claude Code session fetches pages itself, web-searches substitutes for paywalled sources, needs the Claude Code CLI logged in once. "openai": any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint - OpenAI with an API key, or a local model via Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM; dataGrubber fetches each page and the model digests it (no web-search fallback). "command": any other agentic CLI via ai_scrape_command.

ai_scrape_command: for "claude", how to launch Claude Code (leave "" to auto-detect on PATH or inside WSL). For "command", the full CLI template - {prompt} is replaced with the task, e.g. "codex exec {prompt}".

ai_scrape_api_base / ai_scrape_model / ai_scrape_api_key: "openai" provider only. Base like https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1; the key may instead come from the AI_SCRAPE_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY env var (local servers usually need none).
ai_scrape_limit: at most this many links per run, to bound cost; 0 means no cap.
